# Version 4.155.3 (Unreleased)
> **Uno WebAssembly linking fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.3 fixes Uno 6.x WebAssembly linking with the Skia renderer on .NET 9 and later.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Compatible WebGPU linker flags for Uno** — Uno 6.x WebAssembly apps using the Skia renderer no longer receive the conflicting -sUSE_WEBGPU flag on .NET 9 and later, where Dawn supplies WebGPU. The flag remains enabled for .NET 8, which still uses Emscripten's built-in WebGPU port. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5835))
